item.title: Automating Facebook Reels Downloads with Python and yt-dlp
item.description: Learn how to build a custom Python media scraper using yt-dlp to automatically download Facebook page reels with timestamped filenames.

item.title: Topic Modeling in NLP: Comparing LDA vs NMF with Python
item.description: A practical comparison of LDA vs NMF topic modeling algorithms in NLP using Python and Scikit-learn on clinical trial data.

item.title: About Me
item.description:
Welcome to Ecomscript AI!

I am Kalana Ravishanka, a Software Engineer and Artificial Intelligence postgraduate at the University of Salford. With a robust foundation in Computer Science from the University of Colombo, I specialize in software architecture, enterprise integrations, and data science.

Throughout my career, I have worked as a Software Engineer and a Middleware Consultant for enterprise teams, including the Michelin Group and X-Venture Global Solutions. My industry experience revolves around building scalable microservices, event-driven architectures with Kafka, and modern web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Angular.
